cases.sentence: После этого он отстроил города рядом с Ашдодом и в ___ среди филистимлян.
cases.explain: «других местах» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: He went out and fought against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod; and he built cities in the country of Ashdod, and among the Philistines.

cases.sentence: Уззия возвел башни в Иерусалиме над ___, над воротами Долины и на углу стены и укрепил их.
cases.explain: «Угловыми воротами» — after the preposition «над», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall, and fortified them.

cases.sentence: А в горах и на ___ у него трудились землепашцы и виноградари.
cases.explain: «плодородных землях» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: He built towers in the wilderness, and dug out many cisterns, for he had much livestock; in the lowland also, and in the plain. He had farmers and vineyard keepers in the mountains and in the fruitful fields, for he loved farming.

cases.sentence: У Уззии было хорошо обученное войско, готовое выступить на войну по отделениям, по числу в списках, составленных писарем Иеиелом и чиновником Маасеей под руководством Ханании, одного из ___.
cases.explain: «царских сановников» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Moreover Uzziah had an army of fighting men, who went out to war by bands, according to the number of their reckoning made by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king’s captains.

cases.sentence: Общим счетом глав ___ было две тысячи шестьсот человек.
cases.explain: «храбрых воинов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The whole number of the heads of fathers’ households, even the mighty men of valor, was two thousand six hundred.

cases.sentence: Под их началом было войско из трехсот семи тысяч пятисот воинов, обученных сражаться — ___, чтобы помогать царю в битве против врагов.
cases.explain: «огромная сила» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Under their hand was an army, three hundred seven thousand five hundred, who made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.

cases.sentence: В Иерусалиме он соорудил машины, придуманные ___, чтобы с башен и с углов городских стен пускать стрелы и метать огромные камни.
cases.explain: «искусными мастерами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: In Jerusalem, he made devices, invented by skillful men, to be on the towers and on the battlements, with which to shoot arrows and great stones. His name spread far abroad, because he was marvelously helped until he was strong.

cases.sentence: В Иерусалиме он соорудил машины, придуманные искусными мастерами, чтобы с башен и с углов ___ пускать стрелы и метать огромные камни.
cases.explain: «городских стен» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: In Jerusalem, he made devices, invented by skillful men, to be on the towers and on the battlements, with which to shoot arrows and great stones. His name spread far abroad, because he was marvelously helped until he was strong.

cases.sentence: Он нарушил верность Господу, своему Богу, и вошел в Господень храм, чтобы возжечь жертвенные благовония на ___.
cases.explain: «кадильном жертвеннике» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up, so that he did corruptly, and he trespassed against Yahweh his God; for he went into Yahweh’s temple to burn incense on the altar of incense.

cases.sentence: Когда первосвященник Азария и все ___ посмотрели на него, они увидели, что у него на лбу проказа, и поспешили вывести его оттуда.
cases.explain: «остальные священники» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked at him, and behold, he was leprous in his forehead, and they thrust him out quickly from there. Yes, he himself also hurried to go out, because Yahweh had struck him.

cases.sentence: Он жил в ___, прокаженный, отлученный от Господнего дома.
cases.explain: «отдельном доме» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Uzziah the king was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house, being a leper; for he was cut off from Yahweh’s house. Jotham his son was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.

cases.sentence: Он жил в отдельном доме, прокаженный, отлученный от ___.
cases.explain: «Господнего дома» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Uzziah the king was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house, being a leper; for he was cut off from Yahweh’s house. Jotham his son was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.

cases.sentence: Иотам, его сын, распоряжался в ___ и управлял народом страны.
cases.explain: «царском дворце» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Uzziah the king was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house, being a leper; for he was cut off from Yahweh’s house. Jotham his son was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.

cases.sentence: ___ правления Уззии, от первых до последних, записал пророк Исаия, сын Амоца.
cases.explain: «Прочие события» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, wrote.
